name: Clamp_range
post: ∃ m, ret = .int 64 m ∧ (lo.sle hi → lo.sle m ∧ m.sle hi)

prelude:
/-- A clamp call keeps the heap and returns a value in `[lo, hi]` when `lo ≤ hi`. -/
theorem my_clamp_spec (v lo hi : BitVec 64) (s : HState Val) :
    wpFun prog or0 h0 1 [.int 64 v, .int 64 lo, .int 64 hi]
      (fun r s' => ∃ m : BitVec 64, r = .int 64 m ∧ s'.heap = s.heap ∧
        (lo.toInt ≤ hi.toInt → lo.toInt ≤ m.toInt ∧ m.toInt ≤ hi.toInt)) s := by
  have pf1 : prog.funcs[1]? = some f1 := rfl
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt pf1
  wp_auto pf1 [f1]

theorem ca_heap_key (h : Heap Val) (r : Nat) (ys : List (BitVec 64))
    (hh : h[r]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64)))) (i : Nat) (v : BitVec 64) :
    (h.setIfInBounds r (.arr ((ys.map (.int 64)).set i (.int 64 v))))[r]? =
      some (.arr ((ys.set i v).map (.int 64))) := by
  obtain ⟨hsize, _⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hh
  simp [List.map_set, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds, hsize]

theorem ca_set_all {ys : List (BitVec 64)} {k : Nat} {m : BitVec 64} (R : BitVec 64 → Prop)
    (J : Int) (hk : (k : Int) = J) (hm : R m)
    (hall : ∀ t (ht : t < ys.length), (t : Int) ≤ J - 1 → R ys[t]) :
    ∀ t (ht : t < (ys.set k m).length), (t : Int) ≤ J → R (ys.set k m)[t] := by
  intro t ht hle
  have ht' : t < ys.length := by simpa using ht
  by_cases htk : k = t
  · subst htk
    simp [List.getElem_set, hm]
  · have hne : (ys.set k m)[t] = ys[t] := by simp [List.getElem_set, htk]
    rw [hne]
    exact hall t ht' (by omega)

/-! SpecClampAll (f6): the loop at block 3. -/

def sfInv (ref : Nat) (len lo hi : BitVec 64) (ys : List (BitVec 64))
    (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 17 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[1]? = some (.int 64 lo) ∧
  env[2]? = some (.int 64 hi) ∧ env[6]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
  ∃ i : BitVec 64, env[3]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ -1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt < len.toInt

theorem sf_step (ref : Nat) (len lo hi : BitVec 64) (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (hr : ref ≠ 0)
    (hlen : len.toInt = ys.length)
    (hrange : ∀ t (ht : t < ys.length), lo.toInt ≤ ys[t].toInt ∧ ys[t].toInt ≤ hi.toInt) :
    ∀ n env s, sfInv ref len lo hi ys env s →
      (∀ env' s', sfInv ref len lo hi ys env' s' →
        wpPtN prog or0 h0 n ⟨6, 3⟩ (fun r _ => r = .bool true) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 (n + 1) ⟨6, 3⟩ (fun r _ => r = .bool true) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  have pf : prog.funcs[6]? = some f6 := rfl
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, hv0, hv1, hv2, hv6, hh, i, hv3, hlo, hhi⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv1
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv2
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv3
  obtain ⟨_, e6⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv6
  apply wpPtN_of_block pf rfl
  wp_simp [f6]
  simp [e3, e6, hsz]
  generalize hj : i + 1#64 = j
  have hj1 : j.toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [← hj, BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  have hjn0 : 0 ≤ j.toInt := by omega
  have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hjn0
  cases hc : j.slt len
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f6] as q
    try simp [hsz]
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    try dsimp only
    have hju : j.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hjn0 hc
    have hjx : j.toNat < ys.length := by omega
    have hload := heapLoad_arr (k := j.toNat) hr hh (by simpa using hjx)
    have hrj := hrange j.toNat hjx
    wp_step pf [f6] as q
    simp [e0, e1, hsz, dp_indexAddr hju, hload]
    cases hx : (ys[j.toNat]'hjx).slt lo
    · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hx
      try dsimp only
      wp_step pf [f6] as q
      simp [e2, hsz]
      cases hy : hi.slt (ys[j.toNat]'hjx)
      · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hy
        try dsimp only
        refine wpPtN_le (show q ≤ q + 1 + 1 by omega) (ih _ _ ?_)
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [hsz]
        · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e0) | (simp [hsz, e0]; done)
        · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e1) | (simp [hsz, e1]; done)
        · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e2) | (simp [hsz, e2]; done)
        · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e6) | (simp [hsz, e6]; done)
        · first | exact hh | simpa using hh
        · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz, e3]; done)
        · omega
        · omega
      · exfalso
        simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hy
        omega
    · exfalso
      simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hx
      omega

theorem spec_true (len : BitVec 64) (ref : Nat) (lo hi : BitVec 64) (ys : List (BitVec 64))
    (hlen : len.toInt = ys.length) (hr : ref ≠ 0) (s : HState Val)
    (hh : s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))))
    (hrange : lo.toInt ≤ hi.toInt → ∀ t (ht : t < ys.length),
      lo.toInt ≤ ys[t].toInt ∧ ys[t].toInt ≤ hi.toInt) :
    wpFun prog or0 h0 6 [.slice ref 0 len len, .int 64 lo, .int 64 hi]
      (fun r _ => r = .bool true) s := by
  have pf : prog.funcs[6]? = some f6 := rfl
  have hm1 : (18446744073709551615#64 : BitVec 64).toInt = -1 := by first | decide | rfl | simp
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt pf
  apply wpPt_of_block pf rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f6]
  cases hc : hi.slt lo
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f6] as k
    apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
    apply wpPt_loop pf (sfInv ref len lo hi ys) (sf_step ref len lo hi ys hr hlen (hrange hc))
    refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, ?_, 18446744073709551615#64, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · first | exact hh | simpa using hh
    · omega
    · omega
  · try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f6] as k
    try simp

/-! ClampAll (f2): the loop at block 1. -/

def caInv (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len lo hi : BitVec 64)
    (env : Env Val) (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 15 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[1]? = some (.int 64 lo) ∧
  env[2]? = some (.int 64 hi) ∧ env[4]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  ∃ (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (i : BitVec 64), s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
    ys.length = xs.length ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ -1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt < len.toInt ∧
    ∀ t (ht : t < ys.length), (t : Int) ≤ i.toInt →
      (lo.toInt ≤ hi.toInt → lo.toInt ≤ ys[t].toInt ∧ ys[t].toInt ≤ hi.toInt)

abbrev caPost (ref : Nat) (len lo hi : BitVec 64) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun _ s' => wpFun prog or0 h0 6 [.slice ref 0 len len, .int 64 lo, .int 64 hi]
    (fun r _ => r = .bool true) s'

theorem ca_step (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len lo hi : BitVec 64) (hr : ref ≠ 0)
    (hlen : len.toInt = xs.length) :
    ∀ n env s, caInv xs ref len lo hi env s →
      (∀ env' s', caInv xs ref len lo hi env' s' →
        wpPtN prog or0 h0 n ⟨2, 1⟩ (caPost ref len lo hi) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 (n + 1) ⟨2, 1⟩ (caPost ref len lo hi) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  have pf : prog.funcs[2]? = some f2 := rfl
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨hsz, hv0, hv1, hv2, hv4, ys, i, hh, hyl, hv3, hlo, hhi, hall⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv0
  obtain ⟨_, e1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv1
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv2
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv3
  obtain ⟨_, e4⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hv4
  apply wpPtN_of_block pf rfl
  wp_simp [f2]
  simp [e3, e4, hsz]
  generalize hj : i + 1#64 = j
  have hj1 : j.toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [← hj, BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  have hjn0 : 0 ≤ j.toInt := by omega
  have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hjn0
  cases hc : j.slt len
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_false_iff_not, Int.not_lt] at hc
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f2] as q
    refine spec_true len ref lo hi ys (by omega) hr _ ?_ ?_
    · first | exact hh | simpa using hh
    · intro hlh t ht
      exact hall t ht (by omega) hlh
  · simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    try dsimp only
    have hju : j.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hjn0 hc
    have hjx : j.toNat < ys.length := by omega
    have hload := heapLoad_arr (k := j.toNat) hr hh (by simpa using hjx)
    wp_step pf [f2] as q
    simp [e0, e1, e2, hsz, dp_indexAddr hju, hload]
    refine wpFun_mono ?_ (my_clamp_spec _ lo hi _)
    intro v s' hq
    obtain ⟨m, rfl, hheap, hm⟩ := hq
    have hh' : s'.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) := by rw [hheap]; exact hh
    have st := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat) hr hh' (by simpa using hjx) (.int 64 m)
    wp_step pf [f2] as q
    simp [e0, hsz, dp_indexAddr hju, st]
    refine wpPtN_le (show q ≤ q + 1 + 1 by omega) (ih _ _ ?_)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ys.set j.toNat m, j, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hsz]
    · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e0) | (simp [hsz, e0]; done)
    · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e1) | (simp [hsz, e1]; done)
    · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e2) | (simp [hsz, e2]; done)
    · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz]; exact e4) | (simp [hsz, e4]; done)
    · first
        | exact ca_heap_key s'.heap ref ys hh' j.toNat m
        | simp [List.map_set, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds, (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hh').1]
    · simp [hyl]
    · first | (simp [hsz]; done) | (simp [hsz, e3]; done)
    · omega
    · omega
    · exact ca_set_all (fun y => lo.toInt ≤ hi.toInt → lo.toInt ≤ y.toInt ∧ y.toInt ≤ hi.toInt)
        j.toInt hjn hm (fun t ht h => hall t ht (by omega))
proof:
have hm1 : (18446744073709551615#64 : BitVec 64).toInt = -1 := by first | decide | rfl | simp
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f2
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f2 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f2]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f2 (caInv xs xs_ref xs_len lo hi) (ca_step xs xs_ref xs_len lo hi h_xs_ref h_xs_len)
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, by simp, xs, 18446744073709551615#64, ?_, rfl, by simp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · first | exact h_xs | simpa using h_xs
  · omega
  · omega
  · intro t ht hle

    omega

prelude:
theorem hdf3 : prog.funcs[3]? = some f3 := rfl

/-- At the outer header (block 1): `i` (value 1) is the last index visited
(-1 at the start), the slice (value 0) and its length (value 3) are unchanged. -/
def hdOuter (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val)
    (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 21 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧
  ∃ i : BitVec 64, env[1]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ -1 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt < len.toInt

/-- At the inner header (block 4): `i1` is value 6 (the outer index), `j` is value 2. -/
def hdInner (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len i1 : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val)
    (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 21 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  env[6]? = some (.int 64 i1) ∧ 0 ≤ i1.toInt ∧ i1.toInt < len.toInt ∧
  s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (xs.map (.int 64))) ∧
  ∃ j : BitVec 64, env[2]? = some (.int 64 j) ∧ i1.toInt < j.toInt ∧ j.toInt ≤ len.toInt

abbrev hdPost (xs : List (BitVec 64)) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun ret _ => ret = .bool true →
    ∃ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < xs.length) (hj : j < xs.length), i < j ∧ xs[i] = xs[j]

theorem hd_inner (xs : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (href : ref ≠ 0)
    (hlen : len.toInt = xs.length) (n : Nat)
    (ih : ∀ env' s', hdOuter xs ref len env' s' →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 n ⟨3, 1⟩ (hdPost xs) env' s')
    (i1 : BitVec 64) :
    ∀ M, M ≤ n → ∀ env s, hdInner xs ref len i1 env s →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 M ⟨3, 4⟩ (hdPost xs) env s := by
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  intro M
  induction M using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind M ihm =>
  intro hMn env s hJ
  obtain ⟨jsz, h0', h3', h6', hi0, hi1, jh, j, h2', hij, hjl⟩ := hJ
  obtain ⟨_, e0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h0'
  obtain ⟨_, e3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h3'
  obtain ⟨_, e6⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h6'
  obtain ⟨_, e2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp h2'
  wp_step hdf3 [f3] as M1
  simp [e0, e2, h0', h2', jsz]
  cases hc : j.slt len
  · -- j ≥ len: back to the outer header with i := i1
    try dsimp only
    apply wpPtN_le (show M1 ≤ n by omega) (ih _ _ _)
    unfold hdOuter
    refine ⟨by simp [jsz], ?_, ?_, ?_, i1, ?_, by omega, hi1⟩
    · first | (simp [jsz, h0']; done) | (simpa [jsz] using e0) | (simp [jsz]; exact e0)
    · first | (simp [jsz, h3']; done) | (simpa [jsz] using e3) | (simp [jsz]; exact e3)
    · first | exact jh | simpa using jh
    · first | (simp [jsz, h6']; done) | (simpa [jsz] using e6) | (simp [jsz]; exact e6)
  · -- j < len: compare xs[i1] with xs[j]
    simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    try dsimp only
    have hj0 : 0 ≤ j.toInt := by omega
    have hiu : i1.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hi0 hi1
    have hju : j.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt hj0 hc
    have hin : (i1.toNat : Int) = i1.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hi0
    have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hj0
    have hix : i1.toNat < xs.length := by omega
    have hjx : j.toNat < xs.length := by omega
    have hj1 : (j + 1#64).toInt = j.toInt + 1 := by
      rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
    have l1 := heapLoad_arr (r := ref) (k := i1.toNat) href jh (by simpa using hix)
    have lj := heapLoad_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat) href jh (by simpa using hjx)
    by_cases hx : xs[i1.toNat] = xs[j.toNat]
    · -- equal: block 6 returns true
      wp_step hdf3 [f3] as M2
      simp [e0, e2, e6, h0', h2', h6', jsz, dp_indexAddr hiu, dp_indexAddr hju, l1, lj, hx]
      wp_step hdf3 [f3] as M3
      intro _
      exact ⟨i1.toNat, j.toNat, hix, hjx, by omega, hx⟩
    · -- different: block 7 increments j
      wp_step hdf3 [f3] as M2
      simp [e0, e2, e6, h0', h2', h6', jsz, dp_indexAddr hiu, dp_indexAddr hju, l1, lj, hx]
      wp_step hdf3 [f3] as M3
      try simp [jsz, e2, h2']
      apply ihm M3 (by omega) (by omega)
      unfold hdInner
      refine ⟨by simp [jsz], ?_, ?_, ?_, hi0, hi1, ?_, j + 1#64, ?_, by omega, by omega⟩
      · first | (simp [jsz, h0']; done) | (simpa [jsz] using e0) | (simp [jsz]; exact e0)
      · first | (simp [jsz, h3']; done) | (simpa [jsz] using e3) | (simp [jsz]; exact e3)
      · first | (simp [jsz, h6']; done) | (simpa [jsz] using e6) | (simp [jsz]; exact e6)
      · first | exact jh | simpa using jh
      · first | (simp [jsz]; done) | (simp [jsz, h2']; done)

name: BubbleSort_perm
post: ∃ ys : List (BitVec 64), s'.heap[a_ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧ ys.Perm a
prelude:
/-- At the outer header (block 1, `i` is value 1). -/
def bblOuter (a : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val)
    (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 35 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  ∃ (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (i : BitVec 64), s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
    ys.Perm a ∧ env[1]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧ 0 ≤ i.toInt ∧ i.toInt ≤ len.toInt

/-- At the inner header (block 4, `j` is value 2), inside round `i`. -/
def bblInner (a : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len i : BitVec 64) (env : Env Val)
    (s : HState Val) : Prop :=
  env.size = 35 ∧ env[0]? = some (.slice ref 0 len len) ∧ env[3]? = some (.int 64 len) ∧
  env[1]? = some (.int 64 i) ∧
  ∃ (ys : List (BitVec 64)) (j : BitVec 64), s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧
    ys.Perm a ∧ env[2]? = some (.int 64 j) ∧ 0 ≤ j.toInt ∧ j.toInt + i.toInt + 1 ≤ len.toInt

abbrev bblPost (a : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) : Val → HState Val → Prop :=
  fun _ s => ∃ ys : List (BitVec 64), s.heap[ref]? = some (.arr (ys.map (.int 64))) ∧ ys.Perm a

set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in
theorem bbl_inner (a : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len i : BitVec 64) (hr : ref ≠ 0)
    (hlen : len.toInt = a.length) (hi0 : 0 ≤ i.toInt) (hil : i.toInt < len.toInt) (K : Nat)
    (ih : ∀ env' s', bblOuter a ref len env' s' →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 K ⟨0, 1⟩ (bblPost a ref) env' s') :
    ∀ M, M ≤ K → ∀ env s, bblInner a ref len i env s →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 M ⟨0, 4⟩ (bblPost a ref) env s := by
  have pf : prog.funcs[0]? = some f0 := rfl
  have hL : len.toInt < 2 ^ 63 := by have := @BitVec.toInt_lt 64 len; simpa using this
  have hsub : (len - i).toInt = len.toInt - i.toInt := by
    rw [BitVec.toInt_sub_of_not_ssubOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.ssubOverflow] <;> omega
  have hi1' : (i + 1#64).toInt = i.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  intro M
  induction M using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind M ihm =>
  intro hMK env s hJ
  obtain ⟨jsz, e0', e3', e1', ys, j, jh, jp, e2', hj0, hjb⟩ := hJ
  obtain ⟨_, q0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e0'
  obtain ⟨_, q3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e3'
  obtain ⟨_, q1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e1'
  obtain ⟨_, q2⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e2'
  have hsize : ref < s.heap.size := (Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp jh).1
  have hzlen : ys.length = a.length := jp.length_eq
  have hj1' : (j + 1#64).toInt = j.toInt + 1 := by
    rw [BitVec.toInt_add_of_not_saddOverflow] <;> simp [BitVec.saddOverflow] <;> omega
  have hjn : (j.toNat : Int) = j.toInt := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg hj0
  wp_step pf [f0] as M1
  simp [q1, q2, q3, jsz]
  cases hc : (j + 1#64).slt (len - i)
  · -- leave the inner loop: block 6 adds 1 to i and goes back to the outer header
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f0] as M2
    try simp [q1, jsz]
    refine wpPtN_le ?le (ih _ _ ?inv)
    case le => omega
    case inv =>
      refine ⟨by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        ys, i + 1#64, jh, jp,
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'], by omega, by omega⟩
  · -- continue: compare a[j] with a[j+1]
    simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    try dsimp only
    have hju : j.ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) (by omega)
    have hj1u : (j + 1#64).ult len = true := ult_of_toInt (by omega) (by omega)
    have hjx : j.toNat < ys.length := by omega
    have hj1x : j.toNat + 1 < ys.length := by omega
    have hk' : (j + 1#64).toNat = j.toNat + 1 := by
      have := toNat_of_toInt_nonneg (i := j + 1#64) (by omega)
      omega
    have hkm : (j.toNat + 1) % 18446744073709551616 = j.toNat + 1 :=
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : BitVec 64, ys[j.toNat]'hjx = x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : BitVec 64, ys[j.toNat + 1]'hj1x = y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have lx : heapLoad s.heap (.ptr ref [j.toNat]) = .ok (.int 64 x) := by
      rw [heapLoad_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat) hr jh (by simpa using hjx)]
      simp [hx]
    have ly : heapLoad s.heap (.ptr ref [j.toNat + 1]) = .ok (.int 64 y) := by
      rw [heapLoad_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat + 1) hr jh (by simpa using hj1x)]
      simp [hy]
    have st1 := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat) hr jh (by simpa using hjx) (.int 64 y)
    have jh1 : (s.heap.setIfInBounds ref (.arr ((ys.map (.int 64)).set j.toNat (.int 64 y))))[ref]? =
        some (.arr ((ys.map (.int 64)).set j.toNat (.int 64 y))) := by
      first
        | (simp [Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds, hsize]; done)
        | (simp [Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds]; exact hsize)
    have st2 := heapStore_arr (r := ref) (k := j.toNat + 1) hr jh1 (by simpa using hj1x) (.int 64 x)
    have hp2 : ((ys.set j.toNat y).set (j.toNat + 1) x).Perm ys := by
      subst hx
      subst hy
      exact List.set_set_perm hjx hj1x
    wp_step pf [f0] as M2
    simp [q0, q1, q2, q3, jsz, lx, ly, hk', hkm, dp_indexAddr hju, dp_indexAddr hj1u]
    cases hgt : y.slt x
    · -- in order: block 8 adds 1 to j
      try dsimp only
      wp_step pf [f0] as M3
      try simp [q0, q1, q2, q3, jsz]
      apply ihm M3 (by omega) (by omega)
      refine ⟨by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        ys, j + 1#64, jh, jp,
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'], by omega, by omega⟩
    · -- swap in block 7, then block 8 adds 1 to j
      try dsimp only
      wp_step pf [f0] as M3
      simp [q0, q1, q2, q3, jsz, lx, ly, st1, st2, hk', hkm, dp_indexAddr hju, dp_indexAddr hj1u]
      wp_step pf [f0] as M4
      try simp [q0, q1, q2, q3, jsz]
      apply ihm M4 (by omega) (by omega)
      refine ⟨by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'],
        (ys.set j.toNat y).set (j.toNat + 1) x, j + 1#64, ?_, hp2.trans jp,
        by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q2, q3, e0', e1', e2', e3'], by omega, by omega⟩
      first
        | (simp [List.map_set, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds, hsize, hk', hkm]; done)
        | (simp [List.map_set, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds, hk', hkm]; exact hsize)

theorem bbl_step (a : List (BitVec 64)) (ref : Nat) (len : BitVec 64) (hr : ref ≠ 0)
    (hlen : len.toInt = a.length) :
    ∀ n env s, bblOuter a ref len env s →
      (∀ env' s', bblOuter a ref len env' s' →
        wpPtN prog or0 h0 n ⟨0, 1⟩ (bblPost a ref) env' s') →
      wpPtN prog or0 h0 (n + 1) ⟨0, 1⟩ (bblPost a ref) env s := by
  have pf : prog.funcs[0]? = some f0 := rfl
  have hz : (0#64 : BitVec 64).toInt = 0 := by first | decide | rfl | simp
  intro n env s hI ih
  obtain ⟨jsz, e0', e3', ys, i, hh, hp, e1', hi0, hil⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨_, q0⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e0'
  obtain ⟨_, q3⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e3'
  obtain ⟨_, q1⟩ := Array.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp e1'
  apply wpPtN_of_block pf rfl
  wp_simp [f0]
  simp [q1, q3, jsz]
  cases hc : i.slt len
  · -- exit: block 3 returns
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f0] as n
    first
      | exact ⟨ys, hh, hp⟩
      | (refine ⟨ys, ?_, hp⟩; simpa using hh)
  · -- body: block 2 starts the inner loop with j := 0
    simp only [BitVec.slt, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    try dsimp only
    wp_step pf [f0] as n
    refine bbl_inner a ref len i hr hlen hi0 hc _ ih _ (by omega) _ _ ?_
    refine ⟨by simp [jsz], by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q3, e0', e1', e3'],
      by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q3, e0', e1', e3'], by simp [jsz, q0, q1, q3, e0', e1', e3'],
      ys, 0#64, hh, hp, by simp [jsz], by omega, by omega⟩
proof:
have hz : (0#64 : BitVec 64).toInt = 0 := by first | decide | rfl | simp
  apply wpFun_of_wpPt prog_f0
  apply wpPt_of_block prog_f0 rfl
  intro k
  wp_simp [f0]
  apply wpPtN_of_wpPt
  apply wpPt_loop prog_f0 (bblOuter a a_ref a_len) (bbl_step a a_ref a_len h_a_ref h_a_len)
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp, a, 0#64, h_a, List.Perm.refl _, by simp, by omega, by omega⟩
